observation.criterion: exact isotope-envelope match on raw centroided MS2: the observed cluster is anchored on its most abundant isotope and walked with a monotone cursor, missing slots count as zero, and the full-slot Pearson must clear the kernel's correlation floor. A hit on M+2 is a hit; the isotope offset is reported, not normalized away

models.label: 1-52, Met retained: +317.3906 Da at N-terminus (search span 1-4)

differences.note: predictedDiffer counts ions whose theoretical m/z differs between models; predictedIdentical counts ions every model predicts at the same m/z (numerically identical) — those share m/z predictions; isotope compositions may still differ. measuredDiffer counts ions where the kernel's accepted matches differ between models. Whether a predicted difference is resolvable under this measurement depends on tolerance, charge ceiling and interference — reported as conditions, not pre-judged here.
differences.ambiguity: identity, sequence, modification identity and site localization are different questions: matchedBy on an ion covering a differing site speaks to placement; compositionDeltaDa speaks to composition; neither alone establishes identity.

roleGlossary.discriminator: models predict different m/z for this ion; a match here separates them
roleGlossary.sharedMatch: matched by some model but not marked discriminating by the kernel
roleGlossary.noAcceptedMatch: prediction differs but no model obtained an accepted envelope match — absence of acceptance, not evidence of absence
roleGlossary.degenerateMatch: every model predicts the same m/z and the ion is matched — measured, but it separates nothing among degenerateAmong; it grounds span/window statements only

verdict.contestedPeakNote: observed peaks matched by more than one model/ion pair — read them before counting either model's match as independent support

siteWindows.note: leftCleavage/rightCleavage count the model's own cleavages around the site; matchedLeft/matchedRight count how many were observed

uninformative.note: identicalPrediction: ions every model predicts at the same m/z (numerically identical — not a separability claim) — they can share m/z, not necessarily isotope composition. noModelMatched: ions whose prediction differs but which no model obtained an accepted envelope match on any measured scan — an unaccepted match is absence of acceptance, not evidence of absence, unless observability is argued. The matched subset of identicalPrediction is not dropped silently — verdict.degenerateMatched lists those ions with the models they cannot separate and their full measured values. This block counts the verdict's remainder; it is not a second verdict
